sn46.24:1.1: ayoniso bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati,
sn46.24:1.2: anuppanno ceva vyāpādo uppajjati, uppanno ca vyāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati.
sn46.24:1.3: anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati.
sn46.24:1.4: anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati.
sn46.24:1.5: anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati.
sn46.24:1.6: anuppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo nuppajjati, uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo nirujjhati …pe… anuppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo nuppajjati, uppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo nirujjhati.
sn46.24:2.1: yoniso bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando nuppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando pahīyati.
sn46.24:2.2: anuppanno ceva vyāpādo nuppajjati, uppanno ca vyāpādo pahīyati.
sn46.24:2.3: anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṃ nūppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ pahīyati.
sn46.24:2.4: anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ nūppajjati, uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīyati.
sn46.24:2.5: anuppannaṃ ceva vicikicchā nūppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā pahīyati.
sn46.24:3.1: anuppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati …pe… anuppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatīti.
